cohort: The study included patients undergoing childbirth in maternity wards.
finding: The probability of C-section increases at a decreasing rate with workload, a finding primarily observed in single patients and attributed to C-sections being used to alleviate midwives' workload.
mod_finding: C-sections are used to alleviate midwives' workload because they are faster than vaginal births and performed by physicians, leading to an increased probability of C-section at higher workload levels, especially for single patients.
